description: THE LAST AUDIT ON FILE FOR AN ACCOUNT, IN FULL. Pass who (an X handle). Rendered from the snapshot's own stored card — what the audit actually concluded, not a re-run. The grade and organic score, the account's followers / following / posts, median engagement units and estimated honest rate, EVERY FLAG WITH ITS SIGNED POINT DELTA (the score is their sum — showing them is what makes the number arguable), where the engagement comes from, and Rokha's written read. Audits are informational — since 2026-09-24 they do not change Tailwind scoring. Public, no auth.
name: audit_history
title: Audit History
